seoTitle: Visual Studio Code: Features, Pricing & Alternatives
metaDescription: Visual Studio Code is Microsoft's free, open-source code editor for Windows, macOS and Linux, with debugging, Git, extensions and built-in AI agents. See its features, pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Visual Studio Code is a free, open-source code editor from Microsoft for Windows, macOS and Linux. It includes IntelliSense, built-in debugging, integrated testing and Git, and supports JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML and CSS out of the box, with extensions adding hundreds of other languages.

AI is built in: GitHub Copilot comes with VS Code, and you can run agents locally or in the cloud with Copilot or third-party providers such as Claude and OpenAI. You can choose models from several providers or bring your own key. The editor itself is free; AI usage depends on your GitHub Copilot plan, which includes a free tier.

features.title: Smart editing
features.text: IntelliSense code completion, multi-cursor editing, refactoring and rich code navigation.

features.title: Debugging and testing
features.text: Set breakpoints and step through code, and run tests for major frameworks in the editor.

features.title: Built-in Git
features.text: Stage, commit, branch and review changes from the Source Control view.

features.title: Extensions
features.text: Add languages, linters, debuggers, themes and tools from a large extension marketplace.

features.title: AI agents and chat
features.text: GitHub Copilot is built in, with agents from Copilot, Claude or Codex and a choice of models.

features.title: MCP support
features.text: Install and manage MCP servers to give AI agents access to tools and data.

useCases: Everyday coding in almost any language
Web development with JavaScript and TypeScript
AI-assisted coding with Copilot or other agents
A shared standard editor for teams
strengths: Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux.
A huge extension marketplace for languages and tools.
AI agents and models from several providers, or bring your own key.
limitations: AI features beyond the free Copilot tier need a paid GitHub Copilot plan.
Inline suggestions and semantic search need a GitHub sign-in; bring-your-own-key covers chat only.
Many features depend on extensions, which vary in quality and upkeep.
It's a code editor, not a full IDE for every language out of the box.

pricing.summary: VS Code is free. AI features use your GitHub Copilot plan, which has a free tier; you can also use chat with your own API key from another provider.
